_comment: The simulated high-rate encoder for psdaq.sim.rogue_dev: the KCU (PgpMonitor over AxiMemMap, psdaq/cas/pgpmonitor.py, root 'PgpMonitor') and the driver's /proc text, and the encoder board behind SRPv3 on the lane's VC 0 (high_rate_encoder_dev.Root, root 'Root'). Keys are pyrogue register paths; values are what the hardware reports.
